safe.label: Safe
safe.description: Read-only queries, searches, and status checks with no side effects

normal.label: Normal
normal.description: Limited, reversible writes, such as saving memories, creating to-dos, or writing to the knowledge base

sensitive.label: Sensitive
sensitive.description: Sending messages or files out, installing Skills, and external MCP tools by default

dangerous.label: Dangerous
dangerous.description: High-risk or irreversible actions, such as the shell, subagents, deleting data, or removing group members

strict.label: Conservative: only Safe tools run without approval; everything else needs manual approval
strict.hint: Safe needs no approval; Normal, Sensitive, and Dangerous need manual approval

balanced.label: Balanced: Safe and Normal need no approval, Sensitive is auto-approved, Dangerous is manual
balanced.hint: Safe and Normal need no approval; a model auto-approves Sensitive; Dangerous needs manual approval

autonomous.label: Autonomous: Safe and Normal need no approval; Sensitive and Dangerous are auto-approved
autonomous.hint: Safe and Normal need no approval; a model auto-approves Sensitive and Dangerous

full_access.label: Full access: no approval at any level
full_access.hint: Tools at every risk level run without approval
